Hello @pleerock 
I hope your are fine ;)

We have the same concern reported by users of the `@tsed/typeorm` module since Typescript 4.8.x.
For now i have asked users to revert to typescript 4.7.4 pending a fix.

See you and have a nice day ! 
Romain

I am revert to typescript 4.7.4 and it works fine.

### Description of change

TypeScript 4.8 will include stricter assignability rules for unconstrained type parameters. Our [error detection infrastructure](https://github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/issues/49461) caught several build failures in your codebase due to that change.

Nearly throughout the codebase, type parameters named `Entity` were unconstrained. However, they were usually eventually assigned to something constrained to `ObjectLiteral` which is guaranteed to be non-nullable. An unconstrained type parameter `Entity` may be instantiated with `null` or `undefined`, so this was unsafe, and TypeScript 4.8 will fix this bug. I went ahead and updated your codebase as I was investigating the real-world effects of this fix.
